# Luong Nguyen

> AI & Cybersecurity Engineer based in Paris, France. 10+ years building secure backend systems and AI/LLM-powered tools. Creator of claude-howto (17k+ GitHub stars), agent-skill-manager, and sleek-ui.

## About

Luong Nguyen (luongnv89) is a Senior Engineer at Montimage specializing in AI agent workflows, LLM applications, and network security (deep packet inspection). Active open-source contributor and technical writer focused on Claude Code and AI tooling.

## OSS Projects

- [claude-howto](https://github.com/luongnv89/claude-howto): Visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code — 17k+ stars
- [agent-skill-manager](https://luongnv.com/asm): Universal skill manager for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.)
- [sleek-ui](https://luongnv.com/sleek-ui): Modern, minimal UI component library
- [cc-context-stats](https://github.com/luongnv89/cc-context-stats): Real-time Claude Code context usage monitoring
- [music-cli](https://music-cli.luongnv.com): Command-line music player for coders
- [vscode-markdown-preview](https://luongnv.com/vscode-markdown-preview): Clean markdown preview for VS Code
- [skills](https://github.com/luongnv89/skills): Reusable skill library for AI agents

## Games

Browser games, no install — click and play. Free to share.

- [Cờ Toán: Bàn Cờ Sống](https://luongnv.com/games/co-toan-3d/): 3D Vietnamese Math Chess — move numbered stones, form arithmetic pairs, and capture the opposing 0
- [Night Spin](https://luongnv.com/games/night-spin/): Party roulette — numbers, Truth or Dare, xúc xắc, custom actions; physics spin and spin history
- [Orbital Linefall](https://luongnv.com/games/orbital-linefall/): Space-themed falling-block puzzle — clear 20 glowing layers in an angled orbital well
- [Switch Heist](https://luongnv.com/games/santos-chaos/): Top-down heist — switch between three crooks to crack the vault and outrun the heat
- [Arcade Bloodline](https://luongnv.com/games/mortal-combat/): 3D side-on arcade fighter — best-of-three rounds and a finishing strike
- [Codex of Duty](https://luongnv.com/games/codex-of-duty/): Three.js + Rapier FPS with a streaming open world and tactical enemy AI
- [Open Skies](https://luongnv.com/games/open-skies/): Cockpit combat flight sim — guns, fighters, graded landings; phone stick controls, offline
- [Neon Snake](https://luongnv.com/games/neon-snake/): Classic snake with a glowing trail and a speed ramp
- [Flappy Bird — Dash](https://luongnv.com/games/flappy-bird/): One-tap flap arcade — thread the scrolling green pipes and survive as long as you can
- [Geometry Dash — Flux](https://luongnv.com/games/geometry-dash-flux/): Single-button rhythm platformer
- [Minecraft Style](https://luongnv.com/games/minecraft-style/): Voxel block-miner survival — mine across three escalating biomes, build a shelter, and survive the night against mobs
